title: Kab aaoge baba
body:
tha shaam ke zindan mein sakina ka ye nauha
kab aaoge baba
ab aur kahan tak mujhe rulwaoge baba
kab aaoge baba
<<DIVIDER>>
ab bhi na khabar li to mai zinda na rahungi
mai bach na sakungi
dil kaampta hai dekh ke zindan ka andhera
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek raat bhi mai chain se sone nahi paayi
ammu hai na bhai
phat jaye kahin shiddat e gham se na kaleja
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhaiya ali akbar hai na qasim hai na ammu
roothe hai ye sab kyun
chillaati hoo ro ro ke koi bhi nahi aata
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mera muqaddar hai yehi khaak pe sona
takiya na bichona
sone ke liye aap ka seena na milega
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai kaise yaqeen karloo ke faryad ye meri
tum tak nahi pahunchi
sunte rahe aur haal bhi mera nahi poocha
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
be-parda phiraye gaye bazaaron mein jis dam
kyun mar na gaye hum
har gaam pe maine tumhe ro ro ke pukara
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ko bulaade koi ghut'ta hai mera dam
hai waqt bahot kam
bekas ki to faryad bhi koi nahi sunta
kab aaoge baba
tha shaam ke zindan...
